content:
“我为杨天明守身如玉这么多年，他竟然想要甩了我，还嫌弃我不生孩子……明明是他自己有问题不能生育！”说着，江颜又主动脱掉旗袍，迷人的身子扑入陈青云的怀中。“青云，要了我吧！”江颜在他耳畔呢喃。听到这话，陈青云心中的火焰彻底点燃，翻身将江颜按在大床上。江颜媚眼如丝，替陈青云脱掉了衣物，动作温柔的就像是个新婚妻子。陈青云喘着粗气，从后面抱住了江颜，压上她那如蜜桃般鲜美多汁的身子。此刻，杨天明就躺在床上，近在咫尺，陈青云却压在他的妻子江颜身上，有种在高空走钢丝的刺激感。江颜紧咬红唇，娇躯颤抖，强忍着不至于叫出声。长夜漫漫，无限疯狂！陈青云只觉得销魂蚀骨，终于尝到了这个市歌舞团台柱子的滋味，解锁了各种高难度。从床上到沙发，又让她扶着落地窗，最后甚至在浴缸里……江颜的俏脸艳若桃花，一副满足的样子，玉指在他胸口画着圈圈：“我这些年都白活了，今天和你在一起，才知道原来做女人是这么快活！”“颜姐，以后日子还长，我会每天都让你快乐的！”陈青云搂着她，深深嗅了一口她身上的体香。“青云，我好像真的喜欢上你了！如果你也喜欢我，那就加把劲，到时候我生个孩子，让杨天明这混蛋帮你养！”江颜说道。听到这话，陈青云只觉得更加刺激，恨不得再战三百回合。在不远处的大床上，杨天明睡的很死，鼾声震天，完全没发现自己头顶已经绿油油了！他的情人高露，又发来了好几张高清私密照。一丝不挂，极尽诱惑。“这女人，平时在办公室装高冷，没想到私底下这么反差！”陈青云心中暗道，杨天明这个王八蛋，拥有江颜这样极品的女人，不好好珍惜，竟然还在外面拈花惹草。他立刻掏出手机，将高露发来的私密照拍下来，这可是用来对付她的“武器”。“颜姐，天快亮了，我得走了！否则杨天明醒来，就麻烦了！”陈青云清理了屋内各处的战斗痕迹，恋恋不舍，和江颜告别。“等等！”突然，江颜喊住了他，拿出一张银行卡：“这卡里有十万块钱，是我的私房钱，杨天明不知道，你收着！”“颜姐，我怎么能要你的钱呢？”陈青云连忙推脱。“你就收下吧！男人在外面，多的是花钱的地方！等你哪天发达了，别忘了姐姐就行！”江颜强行将银行卡塞给他。这让陈青云感动不已，觉得江颜是动了真感情，现在自己在她心中的地位，恐怕比正牌丈夫杨天明还高！……接着，陈青云揣着银行卡，悄悄离开了碧水山庄别墅。第二天是周末，不用上班。所以他回家补了一觉，睡到大中午，随便吃了点东西后，出门打车前往白婉茹家。毕竟，杨天明图谋不轨，想要染指唐县长留下的财产，这件事情必须好好商量一下。陈青云知道别墅的密码，很快就来到二楼，走到了白婉茹的卧室门口。“夫人，我来了！”陈青云推开了门。“啊……青云，别进来！”白婉茹开口想要阻止，却晚了一步。陈青云已经走进卧室，视线中，顿时出现了一副劲爆的画面……只见白婉茹身上只披着一件浴袍，应该是刚洗完澡，娇嫩的肌肤上还有未擦干的水珠，那傲人的雪峰将浴袍高高撑起，简直呼之欲出。

更要命的是，此刻她正弯着腰，抬起一条修长的玉腿，准备穿丁字裤，若隐若现，诱惑十足。没想到这个节骨眼，陈青云竟然闯了进来，看到了如此羞人的一幕。“夫人，对不起，我不知道您在穿衣服！”陈青云连忙转身，退出了卧室。但他的脑海中，却忍不住幻想起来。也不知白婉茹刚才洗澡的时候，一丝不挂站在花洒下，会是怎样一副香艳的画面！“青云，我换好衣服了，你进来吧！”过了没多久，白婉茹的声音传了出来。陈青云走了进去，发现她换上了保守的睡袍，却依旧难掩丰腴曼妙的身材曲线。虽然她已经三十六岁，但保养的极好，时间似乎没有在她身上留下什么痕迹。陈青云也流露出欣赏的目光，尽管他刚和江颜疯狂了一夜，但眼前的白婉茹，又是不一样的滋味。成熟美妇，风韵犹存，又是上司的夫人，对他而言诱惑十足。白婉茹望着他，似笑非笑，突然问道：“青云，你是不是已经拿下了江颜？”“夫人，你怎么知道？”陈青云大吃一惊。白婉茹解释道：“老唐虽然死了，但我在县政府办还是有些人脉，知道你已经回到了秘书科，就是杨副县长安排的！”“而且昨天，江颜还专门给我打了电话，打听你的事情，她八成对你有意思！”“夫人，你真是火眼金睛！”陈青云不有赞叹。哪怕白婉茹不在官场，但身为前任县长的夫人，还是十分老辣的。“对了，还有个事！杨副县长野心勃勃，看上了唐县长留下的财产，想要占为己有，他让我安排在晚上和你见面，恐怕不安好心。”陈青云正色道。“什么？！”听到这话，白婉茹脸色大变，心中后怕。她知道唐志华一死，难免有人把主意打到她们母女俩的身上，但没想到除了县委书记赵天雄，杨天明也居心叵测！“我果然没看错你，那现在该怎么办？”白婉茹紧紧贴着他问道。陈青云说道：“夫人，那杨天明外强中干，难成大事，只要抓住他的把柄，就能轻松拿捏！”“咱们将计就计，既然他对你有意思，你就这样……”陈青云在她的耳畔，低语了几句。听了后，白婉茹连连点头，心中更是庆幸，还好宝压在陈青云的身上，为自己和女儿找了个避风港。“青云，这次真是多亏了你！”白婉茹感激道。“夫人，那你要怎么感谢我？”陈青云眼神火辣，在她的娇躯上打量起来。“这个……你想要什么？”白婉茹眼神躲闪，脸颊发烫，不敢和他对视。“咦，这是什么？”陈青云坐在床上，突然发现枕头下有个东西膈着自己。拿出来一看，却发现是个粉色的成人玩具，上面似乎还沾着水渍，应该是白婉茹晚上用来安慰自己的。她正是如狼似虎的年纪，守活寡的滋味，可不好受！“夫人，唐县长死后的这些日子，你也很寂寞吧？”陈青云坏坏一笑，向她靠了过去。　　请记住本书首发域名：fzhldax。顶点小说网手机版阅读网址：fzhldax

"I have been keeping my virginity for Yang Tianming for so many years, but he actually wants to dump me, and even dislikes me for not having children... It's obvious that he has some problems and cannot have children!" After saying that, Jiang Yan took off her cheongsam and threw her charming body into Chen Qingyun's arms."Qingyun, take me!" Jiang Yan whispered in his ear.Hearing this, the fire in Chen Qingyun's heart was completely ignited, and he turned over and pressed Jiang Yan on the big bed.With her charming eyes, Jiang Yan took off Chen Qingyun's clothes as gently as a newlywed wife.Panting heavily, Chen Qingyun hugged Jiang Yan from behind and pressed against her body as juicy as a peach.At this moment, Yang Tianming was lying on the bed, close at hand, but Chen Qingyun was pressing on his wife Jiang Yan, giving him the thrill of walking on a tightrope at high altitude.Jiang Yan bit her red lips tightly, her delicate body trembling, trying not to scream.The long night, infinite madness!Chen Qingyun felt ecstasy, finally getting a taste of being the pillar of this city's song and dance troupe, and unlocking all kinds of difficult difficulties.From the bed to the sofa, he let her hold the floor-to-ceiling window, and finally even in the bathtub... Jiang Yan's pretty face was as bright as a peach blossom, with a satisfied look, and her jade fingers drew circles on his chest: "I have lived in vain all these years, and today I am with you, and I realize how happy it is to be a woman!" "Sister Yan, there will be a long time to come, and I will make you happy every day!" Chen Qingyun hugged her and took a deep breath of her body fragrance."Qingyun, I seem to really like you! If you like me too, then work harder. When the time comes, I will give birth to a child and let Yang Tianming, a bastard, help you raise it!" Jiang Yan said.Hearing this, Chen Qingyun only felt more excited and wanted to fight for another three hundred rounds.On the big bed not far away, Yang Tianming slept soundly, snoring so loudly that he didn't realize that the top of his head was already green!His lover Gao Lu sent several more high-definition private photos.Naked, extremely tempting."This woman usually pretends to be aloof in the office, but she didn't expect such a contrast in private!" Chen Qingyun secretly thought to himself, Yang Tianming, a bastard, has a top-notch woman like Jiang Yan, but if he doesn't cherish it, he is still flirting with women outside.He immediately took out his mobile phone and took pictures of the private photos sent by Gao Lu. This was a "weapon" used against her."Sister Yan, it's almost dawn, I have to leave! Otherwise, Yang Tianming will be in trouble when he wakes up!" Chen Qingyun cleaned up the traces of battles everywhere in the house, reluctantly said goodbye to Jiang Yan."Wait!" Suddenly, Jiang Yan stopped him and took out a bank card: "There is 100,000 yuan in this card. It is my private money. Yang Tianming doesn't know about it, so you keep it!" "Sister Yan, how can I ask for your money?" Chen Qingyun quickly shied away."Just accept it! Men are out there, and there are plenty of places to spend money! When you become rich one day, just don't forget about your sister!" Jiang Yan forced the bank card to him.This moved Chen Qingyun so much that he felt that Jiang Yan was really moved by her feelings. Now his status in her heart is probably higher than that of her real husband Yang Tianming!...Then, Chen Qingyun quietly left the Bishui Villa with his bank card in his pocket.The next day is the weekend, so I don't have to go to work.So he went home to catch up on his sleep, slept until noon, had something to eat, and then took a taxi to Bai Wanru's house.After all, Yang Tianming had evil intentions and wanted to get his hands on the property left by County Magistrate Tang. This matter must be discussed carefully.Chen Qingyun knew the password to the villa and quickly arrived on the second floor and walked to Bai Wanru's bedroom door."Madam, I'm here!" Chen Qingyun opened the door."Ah...Qingyun, don't come in!" Bai Wanru opened her mouth to stop him, but was a step too late.Chen Qingyun had already walked into the bedroom, and an exciting scene suddenly appeared in his sight... Bai Wanru was only wearing a bathrobe. She must have just taken a bath, and there were still water drops on her delicate skin that had not been wiped dry. The proud snow peak held the bathrobe high, and she was ready to breathe.

What's even worse is that at this moment, she is bending over, raising a slender jade leg, preparing to wear a thong, looming, full of temptation.Unexpectedly, at this juncture, Chen Qingyun broke in and saw such a shameful scene."Madam, I'm sorry, I didn't know you were getting dressed!" Chen Qingyun quickly turned around and exited the bedroom.But in his mind, he couldn't help but fantasize.I don’t know what kind of sexy scene Bai Wanru would have looked like standing naked under the shower when she took a shower just now!"Qingyun, I've changed my clothes, come in!" Not long after, Bai Wanru's voice came out.Chen Qingyun walked in and found that she had put on a conservative nightgown, but she still couldn't hide her plump and graceful figure.Although she is thirty-six years old, she is extremely well-maintained and time seems to have left no trace on her body.Chen Qingyun also showed admiration. Although he had just spent a crazy night with Jiang Yan, the Bai Wanru in front of him had a different taste.She is a mature and beautiful woman, her charm is still there, and she is the wife of his boss, so she is very tempting to him.Bai Wanru looked at him, half-smiling, and suddenly asked: "Qingyun, have you already captured Jiang Yan?" "Madam, how do you know?" Chen Qingyun was shocked.Bai Wanru explained: "Although Old Tang is dead, I still have some connections in the county government office. I know that you have returned to the secretarial department, which was arranged by Deputy County Magistrate Yang!" "And yesterday, Jiang Yan called me specifically to inquire about you. She is probably interested in you!" "Madam, you are really dazzling!" Chen Qingyun was not impressed.Even though Bai Wanru is no longer in the officialdom, as the wife of the former county magistrate, she is still very sophisticated."By the way, there is one more thing! Deputy County Magistrate Yang is very ambitious. He is interested in the property left by County Magistrate Tang and wants to take it for himself. He asked me to arrange to meet you in the evening. I'm afraid I don't have good intentions." Chen Qingyun said seriously."What?!" After hearing this, Bai Wanru's face changed drastically, and she felt scared.She knew that after Tang Zhihua's death, someone would inevitably target the mother and daughter, but she didn't expect that in addition to the county party secretary Zhao Tianxiong, Yang Tianming also had ulterior motives!"Sure enough, I saw you right, so what should I do now?" Bai Wanru asked, sticking closely to him.Chen Qingyun said: "Madam, it is difficult for Yang Tianming to achieve great things if he is strong on the outside but strong on the inside. As long as you grasp his handle, you can easily manipulate him!" "Let's use the trick. Since he is interested in you, just do this..." Chen Qingyun whispered a few words in her ear.After hearing this, Bai Wanru nodded repeatedly, and felt even more fortunate in her heart. Fortunately, Bao Qing was on top of Chen Qingyun and found a safe haven for herself and her daughter."Qingyun, it's really thanks to you this time!" Bai Wanru said gratefully."Madam, how do you want to thank me?" Chen Qingyun looked at her delicate body with burning eyes."This...what do you want?" Bai Wanru's eyes evaded, her cheeks were hot, and she didn't dare to look at him."Hey, what is this?" Chen Qingyun was sitting on the bed and suddenly found something under the pillow that was stretching him.When she took it out and looked at it, she found that it was a pink adult toy with water stains on it. It should have been used by Bai Wanru to comfort herself at night.She is at the age where she is like a wolf and a tiger, and it is not pleasant to be a widow!"Madam, you were also very lonely these days after County Magistrate Tang died, right?" 更要命的是，此刻她正弯着腰，抬起一条修长的玉腿，准备穿丁字裤，若隐若现，诱惑十足。没想到这个节骨眼，陈青云竟然闯了进来，看到了如此羞人的一幕。“夫人，对不起，我不知道您在穿衣服！”陈青云连忙转身，退出了卧室。但他的脑海中，却忍不住幻想起来。也不知白婉茹刚才洗澡的时候，一丝不挂站在花洒下，会是怎样一副香艳的画面！“青云，我换好衣服了，你进来吧！”过了没多久，白婉茹的声音传了出来。陈青云走了进去，发现她换上了保守的睡袍，却依旧难掩丰腴曼妙的身材曲线。虽然她已经三十六岁，但保养的极好，时间似乎没有在她身上留下什么痕迹。陈青云也流露出欣赏的目光，尽管他刚和江颜疯狂了一夜，但眼前的白婉茹，又是不一样的滋味。成熟美妇，风韵犹存，又是上司的夫人，对他而言诱惑十足。白婉茹望着他，似笑非笑，突然问道：“青云，你是不是已经拿下了江颜？”“夫人，你怎么知道？”陈青云大吃一惊。白婉茹解释道：“老唐虽然死了，但我在县政府办还是有些人脉，知道你已经回到了秘书科，就是杨副县长安排的！”“而且昨天，江颜还专门给我打了电话，打听你的事情，她八成对你有意思！”“夫人，你真是火眼金睛！”陈青云不有赞叹。哪怕白婉茹不在官场，但身为前任县长的夫人，还是十分老辣的。“对了，还有个事！杨副县长野心勃勃，看上了唐县长留下的财产，想要占为己有，他让我安排在晚上和你见面，恐怕不安好心。”陈青云正色道。“什么？！”听到这话，白婉茹脸色大变，心中后怕。她知道唐志华一死，难免有人把主意打到她们母女俩的身上，但没想到除了县委书记赵天雄，杨天明也居心叵测！“我果然没看错你，那现在该怎么办？”白婉茹紧紧贴着他问道。陈青云说道：“夫人，那杨天明外强中干，难成大事，只要抓住他的把柄，就能轻松拿捏！”“咱们将计就计，既然他对你有意思，你就这样……”陈青云在她的耳畔，低语了几句。听了后，白婉茹连连点头，心中更是庆幸，还好宝压在陈青云的身上，为自己和女儿找了个避风港。“青云，这次真是多亏了你！”白婉茹感激道。“夫人，那你要怎么感谢我？”陈青云眼神火辣，在她的娇躯上打量起来。“这个……你想要什么？”白婉茹眼神躲闪，脸颊发烫，不敢和他对视。“咦，这是什么？”陈青云坐在床上，突然发现枕头下有个东西膈着自己。拿出来一看，却发现是个粉色的成人玩具，上面似乎还沾着水渍，应该是白婉茹晚上用来安慰自己的。她正是如狼似虎的年纪，守活寡的滋味，可不好受！“夫人，唐县长死后的这些日子，你也很寂寞吧？”陈青云坏坏一笑，向她靠了过去。　　请记住本书首发域名：fzhldax。顶点小说网手机版阅读网址：fzhldax
